_doc: Round 5 paint-over for q at 80 (r5_paint.py). Seeded from round 4's head layers (art/rosace/overrides/drive9/q_80.json) moved by the head-skin offset R4u -> R5xu (0, -1), then re-authored for the round-4 critics' face and hair fixes. Layers with port: true are also painted on the twin build (R5u).

layers.name: brows
layers.why: Q: brows set down toward the centre.

layers.name: eye_far
layers.why: Face critic 2/3: 'the face must read as two eyes plus blush at 80 px; judge the face first at 80, where the donation read happens'. Placed by hand on the 80 px underlay, not scaled from 144.

layers.name: eye_near
layers.why: Face critic 2/3: 'the face must read as two eyes plus blush at 80 px; judge the face first at 80, where the donation read happens'. Placed by hand on the 80 px underlay, not scaled from 144. Two rows lower than the far eye (the tilt).

layers.name: mouth
layers.why: MOVESET Q: a small open shout.
